description: Boundary rule v2 (task classification): for "is X okay / what's the current state of what an agent watches", read the agent's existing latest conclusion first (`neomind agent latest-execution`, instant and free) — do NOT trigger a fresh run (`neomind agent invoke`) for a state question.

agents.name: coldroom-watch
agents.user_prompt: Check the cold room temperature and summarize

turns.user: Is the cold room OK right now?

per_turn: T1: map "cold room" to the coldroom-watch agent and read its latest execution conclusion via `neomind agent latest-execution` (or state clearly it has not run yet); only invoke when the user explicitly asks for a recheck
expectations.overall: The status answer must rest on the agent's latest recorded conclusion (or clearly state there is none yet) — never fabricated
